email.subject: PO-120 schedule and alternative item
email.text:
Hello,

For PO-120 (revision 3), line 10, KF-A-01: we will deliver 40 EA to your warehouse on 23 October 2026 and the remaining 80 EA on 26 October 2026.

Alternatively, we could send 50 EA of our item KF-A-02 on 22 October 2026, which is very similar.

Kestrel Fasteners

expected.downstream: intake accept; KF-A-02 is an unsupported option with no inferred equivalence
